(rule!
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) 1) (= (obj-c1 o) (obj-c2 o)) (= (obj-size o) 5))) (objects g 0))])
    (set-cell out (quotient (+ (obj-r1 obj) (obj-r2 obj)) 2) (obj-c1 obj) 2)))

(rule!

    (set-cell out (quotient (+ (obj-r1 obj) (obj-r2 obj)) 2) (obj-c1 obj) 2)))

(rule!
  (lambda (g)
    (let* ([markers (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 6)) (objects g 0))]
           [k (obj-size (first markers))])
      (for/fold ([out g])
                ([obj (filter (lambda (o)
                                (and (= (obj-color o) 1)
                                     (= (obj-c1 o) (obj-c2 o))
                                     (= (obj-size o) k)))
                              (objects g 0))])
        (set-cell out (quotient (+ (obj-r1 obj) (obj-r2 obj)) 2)
                      (obj-c1 obj) 2)))))
